findings.source_quote: “Nero fastened the guilt and inflicted the most exquisite tortures on a class hated for their abominations, called Christians by the populace. Mockery of every sort was added to their deaths. Covered with the skins of beasts, they were torn by dogs and perished, or were nailed to crosses, or were doomed to the flames and burnt, to serve as nightly illumination when daylight had expired.”
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri nukuu yote: “Nero aliwatwika hatia na kuwatesa kwa mateso makali kupita kiasi watu waliochukiwa kwa machukizo yao, ambao umma uliwaita Wakristo. Waliongezewa dhihaka za kila aina wakati wa kuuawa kwao. Wakiwa wamefunikwa kwa ngozi za wanyama, waliraruliwa na mbwa na kufa, au walipigiliwa misumari misalabani, au walihukumiwa kuchomwa moto na kuteketezwa ili kutoa mwanga usiku baada ya mwanga wa mchana kuisha.”
findings.translation_quote: “Nero fastened the guilt and inflicted the most exquisite tortures on a class hated for their abominations, called Christians by the populace. Mockery of every sort was added to their deaths. Covered with the skins of beasts, they were torn by dogs and perished, or were nailed to crosses, or were doomed to the flames and burnt, to serve as nightly illumination when daylight had expired.”

findings.source_quote: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. ... Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake –Romans 13: 1-5.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri yaliyomo ndani ya <em> bila kubadili lebo: “Kila mtu na ajitiishe kwa mamlaka zilizo juu yake. Kwa maana hakuna mamlaka isipokuwa kutoka kwa Mungu; na mamlaka zilizopo zimewekwa na Mungu. Kwa hiyo anayepinga mamlaka anapinga agizo la Mungu; nao wanaopinga watajiletea hukumu. Kwa maana watawala si tishio kwa matendo mema, bali kwa maovu. Je, unataka usiogope mamlaka? Tenda yaliyo mema, nawe utasifiwa nayo; kwa maana mtawala ni mtumishi wa Mungu kwa ajili ya mema yako. Lakini ukitenda maovu, ogopa; kwa maana habebi upanga bure: yeye ni mtumishi wa Mungu, mwenye kulipiza kisasi ili kutekeleza ghadhabu juu ya atendaye maovu. Kwa hiyo ni lazima mjitiishe, si kwa sababu ya ghadhabu tu, bali pia kwa ajili ya dhamiri –Warumi 13:1-5.”
findings.translation_quote: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God. Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation. For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil. Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake –Romans 13: 1-5.
